ai_summary: Adroit Industries reported robust Q2 FY27 results, with H1 revenue increasing 11% and EBITDA soaring 48% year-over-year, significantly expanding margins to 29.3%. The company is leveraging IPO funds for a substantial capacity expansion, aiming to double machining and assembly capacity by Q4 FY27 and increase forging capacity by Q1 FY28, which is projected to support annual revenue potential of Rs. 2,500 million. Strategic initiatives include diversifying into industrial and defense segments, expanding international presence, and improving margins through in-house manufacturing, while addressing a high working capital cycle that management expects to optimize without further fundraising.
